method: Unedited native game screenshots after keyboard walking and camera dragging. Same medium quality and1280x720 canvas. Approximate repeated viewpoints, not pixel-aligned captures. Real weather/UTC time continued between visits; night screenshot uses visibly labelled night preview.
checks: R-ko no longer shows the broad gap below the roof; dark11cm edge flashing remains.
Window reflections respond to angle without turning opaque external windows into transparent rooms.
Foundation UV repeat is metric, replacing whole-building stretched rows.
Tree crown shading is more coherent; pale bark and simplified forms remain.
Day/night/F flashlight load without render or console errors.
limits: HUD numbers are not a benchmark.
No GeForce or diverse-avatar performance acceptance.
Generic bark, large terrain shapes, some shop facades/courts and incomplete allowed interiors still limit fidelity.
This iteration does not complete Hogwarts Legacy-level art direction.
